Subject: Re: How do parlays work on Novig?

Hi there,

Welcome to Novig! Thanks for reaching out, and great question — parlays on a peer-to-peer exchange do work a bit differently than at a traditional sportsbook.

On Novig, instead of betting against "the house," you're matched with other users who take the opposite side of your parlay as a whole. The odds/price for a parlay are derived from the combined legs you select, and the exchange works to match your action with another user (or users) willing to take the other side at that price. Other users don't need to individually agree to each leg — they're taking the other side of the full parlay as you've built it, not negotiating leg by leg.

Because pricing and matching can involve some nuances depending on the specific legs and market liquidity, I want to make sure you get fully accurate details. A member of our Novig Support team will follow up with more specifics on how pricing is determined and matched for parlays in your case.

Thanks for your patience, and welcome aboard!

Best,
Novig Support
